name: wake-word-detector
description: Wake word detection for 'hey claude' to open WSL terminals

scripts.dev:main: npm run build:main && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron dist/main/main.js
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
scripts.build:main: tsc src/main/main.ts --outDir dist/main --module commonjs --target es2020 && tsc src/main/preload.ts --outDir dist/main --module commonjs --target es2020
scripts.build-packager: npm run build && electron-packager . "Claude Wake Word Detector" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=release --overwrite --app-copyright="Copyright (C) 2025 Traves Theberge" --app-version="1.0.0" --executable-name="Claude-Wake-Word-Detector" --icon="assets/Install.ico"

author: Traves Theberge
